def: to bind with, i.e. (passively) be a fellow-prisoner (figuratively)

occurrences.text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
